summary:
## Standing operator rules
Treat any field ending in `_secret`, `_token`, or `_fingerprint` as restricted and copy only through `ledgerly.sanitizers.safe_customer_context`.

Always pin new licensing tools to an exact version in `requirements/license-tools.txt` rather than using `>=` or a floating latest version.

Paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing.

The active schema is billing_v3 now. billing_v1 is a frozen snapshot used by finance; never seed or write into it.

## Current objective
Finish the shared-embedding-client refactor for search rebuilds, then keep the Elasticsearch alias swap paused. The dunning scheduler fix remains outstanding.

## Ruled-out approaches
Wrapping webhook handlers in a five-attempt retry decorator caused duplicate customer emails; retrying webhooks is ruled out.

## Recent work
Search rebuilding was optimized with eight workers, 100-document chunks, and tenant-scoped invoice scans; a 5,000-document dry run completed in 1.19s. Search tests passed. The latest change passed a shared embedder into the management command, but other rebuild entry points may remain. Webhook retry changes are ruled out despite passing tests.
